Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

clean — to remove dirt, or not dirty. Example: I clean the kitchen every morning.
cook — to prepare food with heat. Example: I cook breakfast at seven.
wash — to clean with water. Example: I wash the plates after dinner.
open — to move something so it is not closed. Example: Open the window, please.
close — to shut something. Example: Close the door, please.
turn on — to start a machine or light. Example: Turn on the light.
turn off — to stop a machine or light. Example: Turn off the TV.
sleep — to rest with your eyes closed at night. Example: I sleep eight hours.
sit — to rest on a chair or the floor. Example: Sit down, please.
stand — to be on your feet. Example: Stand up, please.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Close the door, please.
• Turn on the light.
• Turn off the TV.
• Don't open the window.
• Can you ...?
